tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Search published Univs.com study programmes by name, country, degree level, teaching language and scholarship availability. Returns tuition, duration, intakes, the programme page URL and whether students can apply through Univs.

query.description: Words in the programme name, e.g. "medicine", "computer science", "MBA".

country.description: Country slug, e.g. "georgia" (see list_countries). Comma-separate up to 5.

degree.description: Degree level slug: bachelor, master, doctorate, diploma, certificate, foundation.

scholarship.description: Only programmes with a listed scholarship.

tools.name: search_institutes
tools.description: Search published Univs.com universities, colleges and institutes by name or city and country. Returns location, type, programme count, tuition-from, the institute page URL and whether students can apply through Univs.

query.description: Institute name or city, e.g. "Tbilisi State".

tools.name: search_agencies
tools.description: Search education agencies and study abroad consultants listed on Univs Agencies by name, office country or city, study destination and language. Returns public profile details (offices by city, destinations, languages, services, reviews) and the profile URL where students contact the agency. Neutral order; no contact details.

query.description: Words in the agency name or profile, e.g. "medicine" or an agency name.

office_country.description: Where the agency has an office: country name or ISO code, e.g. "India" or "IN". Comma-separate up to 5.

destination.description: Study destination the agency helps with: country name or ISO code, e.g. "Georgia" or "GE".

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List the countries covered by the Univs.com catalogue with their slugs, institute counts and page URLs.
